context.en: The portrait and facing biography frame Liu Yuxi as a poet worth remembering in Qing China.
context.zh: 肖像与对页传记呈现清代对刘禹锡这位唐代诗人的追忆。

context.en: This 1609 printed portrait remembers the Song reformer through the dress and tablet of an exemplary official. Its title names Fan Wenzheng, his posthumous honorific.
context.zh: 这幅1609年的版画用礼冠与笏板塑造宋代改革者的官员典范形象；上方题名“范文正”使用了他的谥号。

context.en: The tablet, frontal pose and ceremonial clothing commemorate service to the state. Gu Jianlong painted Yu Qian roughly two centuries after the minister’s execution.
context.zh: 笏板、正面姿态与礼服纪念于谦的国家臣僚身份；顾见龙作画时，距离这位大臣被处死已约两百年。
